text:
sarah_sales: Quick heads-up — Zephyr Health wants to run a HIPAA POC. They need 7yr audit-log retention + HSM-backed KMS for keys. Asking if we can do a 6mo early-commit discount if POC validates.

james_se: We can support this. Compliance add-ons are priced separately: long-term audit retention + HSM integration. Need to confirm whether they want managed HSM or customer-managed KMS.

priya_ps: TL;DR numbers we typically use (ballpark for POC conversations):
- Managed HSM: $1,500/mo + $5k one-time setup (attestation/integration).
- Customer-managed KMS integration: no recurring HSM fee but engineering integration + security review (SOW).
- Audit logs retention: default 90d included; >90d is add-on. Cold archive tier for multi-year retention ~ $0.02/GB/mo; for committed customers we offer a flat 7yr compliance SKU (negotiable).

deal-bot: Provisional rate card: https://redwood.internal/rate-card (see section "Compliance Add-ons") :pushpin:

courtney_legal: We'll need the BAA + updated DPA. For HSM we'll require HSM attestation and a clause around key custody. If they want 7yr retention for HIPAA, also add legal hold export requirements — may impact e-discovery fees.

elaine_re: For the POC ops: recommend running on Dedicated reserved pool in a private VPC to demo end-to-end compliance. For scope: ask Zephyr for expected log ingestion rate. I can pre-provision a 30GB/day ingestion buffer for the first month. If they commit 6mo with a $X/mo committed spend we can bundle the 7yr retention at a discounted flat rate.

james_se: Proposed two options to present to customer (short bullets we can pass to pricing):
A) POC + 6mo committed option: include managed HSM, 7yr retention (flat archival fee), reduced onboarding waiver ($3k -> $1k).
B) POC pay-as-you-go: standard HSM pricing + pay-as-you-go retention ($0.02/GB/mo) and standard onboarding.

priya_ps: If they want a formal quote I need expected monthly storage TB and a target committed ARR. Commit thresholds that usually unlock deeper discounts: $50k/mo, $100k/mo. For a 6mo small POC commit (under $10k/mo) we can offer one-off discount but no deep archival rate change.

sarah_sales: Perfect. I'll ask for their projected log GB/month and whether they prefer managed HSM. Can someone draft a brief quote (option A + B) and a short note of legal requirements? I need to send this to Zephyr this morning. cc @courtney_legal @elaine_re

james_se: I’ll draft the two-line pricing bullets and examples.

courtney_legal: I’ll prepare the BAA checklist and list of SOW items for HSM integration.

elaine_re: I’ll provision the POC env placeholder and set a calendar for a 30-min tech presales call.

sarah_sales: Thanks team :thumbsup:
